record.material_as_written: PVdF-HFP gel electrolyte with LiClO4 in EC:PC (lithium polymer gel electrolyte)
record.synthesis_method: solution mixing (PVdF-HFP dissolved in THF, LiClO4/EC:PC solution added and stirred)
record.evidence_quote: The prepared lithium polymer gel electrolyte has conductivity 0.03
record.notes: Borderline scope: this is a liquid-plasticized polymer gel electrolyte rather than a dry solid. The unit mS/cm and the 25 C temperature are on the following line of the PDF text. The 80:20 wt% gel composition is the paper's stated maximum-conductivity composition. The Mg PGE value (0.5 uS/cm) is not recorded because Mg2+ is not a Li/Na conductor.
